canada.title: 2 Lévis, Que., police officers suspended with pay, but allegations remain unclear
canada.summary: Two police officers from the Service de police de la Ville de Lévis (SPVL) have been suspended with pay following an internal investigation.

canada.title: Gretzky backs Carney’s Russian world junior ban
canada.summary: Wayne Gretzky says he backs Canada's decision to bar Russia from the upcoming world junior hockey championship in Alberta.

canada.title: Hydro-Québec to buy land intended for failed Northvolt electric vehicle battery plant
canada.summary: Hydro-Québec says it has reached an agreement to acquire an 18-million-square-foot parcel of land that was expected to house the failed Northvolt electric vehicle battery plant.

canada.title: Woman dead, man arrested after stabbing in North York: Toronto police
canada.summary: Toronto police are investigating a homicide after a woman died in a stabbing in North York Friday morning.

canada.title: Crown witness changes story at trial for trio accused of Bay Roberts murder
canada.summary: A Crown witness went back on her previous statements to police and testimony at a preliminary hearing, now insisting she either doesn't remember key events, or made them up.

canada.title: Manitoba Métis Federation ‘appalled’ by being left out of budget
canada.summary: The president of the Manitoba Métis Federation says he's 'appalled' that Métis were not included in the federal budget.

canada.title: ‘The fear is real’: Nova Scotia municipal politicians face escalating public harassment
canada.summary: Elected officials from several small towns in Nova Scotia say abuse from residents is becoming more common, especially on social media.

canada.title: Call to renew licensed grizzly bear hunting met with pushback from B.C. conservationists
canada.summary: A call to bring back licensed grizzly bear hunting, closed in B.C. since 2017, has resurfaced after a suspected grizzly attack killed a mother and daughter near Bella Coola — but conservationists argue there’s no evidence that hunting the bears reduces conflict.

canada.title: Sunterra to leave Britannia Plaza after 30 years following court decision on lease
canada.summary: A judge gave the green light for the landlord to evict Sunterra from its Britannia location in Calgary, despite the company’s argument it had an agreement to stay longer, court documents show.

canada.title: Winnipeg addictions and mental health centre promised in budget could be running in 3 years
canada.summary: The millions of dollars in federal funding being earmarked to create a new Winnipeg facility providing mental health and addictions care represents a "massive opportunity" for the city and the province, Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew says.

canada.title: Nova Scotia chooses 2026 Boston Christmas tree from East Amherst
canada.summary: A 14-metre white spruce from Nova Scotia will soon be cut and shipped to Boston as an annual Christmas gift to thank the city for its help after the Halifax Explosion.

canada.title: Indian Act controversy lingers more than a week after abolishment was raised in Ottawa
canada.summary: Everyone has been hashing out just what it could mean to abolish the Indian Act after it was raised by Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew in Ottawa.

canada.title: Landslide prompts evacuation order for village of Zeballos on Vancouver Island
canada.summary: Emergency Info B.C. says the order affects properties on Pandora Crescent and Maquinna Avenue.

canada.title: ‘Devil in the detail’ for how Ottawa’s budget could help long term: MUN economist
canada.summary: Ottawa has released a new budget and MUN economist Lynn Gambin says it could be good news for Newfoundland and Labrador, but it will come down to how it's implemented.

canada.title: Advocates call for more oversight of Nunavut family services after scathing report
canada.summary: After an auditor general of Canada report this week highlighted serious failures by Nunavut's Family Services department over the last decade and half, some advocates in the territory say someone has to be accountable for ensuring every child in care is safe.

canada.title: Fort Smith mother says daughter staying home after suspected recording device found at school
canada.summary: A Fort Smith mother says her daughter has taken time off school after a possible recording device was found in a girls’ changing room this week.

canada.title: U of T dean of dentistry steps down after investigation into antisemitic images in course material
canada.summary: The University of Toronto says its dean of dentistry Anil Kishen voluntarily stepped down following an investigation into his use of antisemitic imagery in February.

canada.title: Disbarred former Manitoba law dean loses extradition fight in French Appeal Court
canada.summary: A document from the Versailles Court of Appeal says the Indictment Division has granted Canada's request to extradite the man. No transfer date was given.
